gaps.reason: the hooks page does not say whether PreToolUse receives MCP tools or under what name (the MCP page names them mcp_<server>_<tool>, which the guard now classifies as mcp by its mcp_ prefix, unproven); an mcp rule may never run here; a live run on 2026-11-18 (agy 1.5.11) was not possible because the account is disabled by the service, so this stays unverified

the PreToolUse input is documented as {toolCall: {name, args}} with args an object, and the guard reads that (a JSON string of args is also decoded); only the key CommandLine appears in the vendor example, so every other argument key it tries (AbsolutePath, TargetFile, SearchPath, SearchDirectory, DirectoryPath, Includes, Pattern, Url, URL, Query) is a guess; a read, write or network rule sees an empty resource when the real key differs, and an empty resource matches only the pattern '' and patterns made only of '*'
Antigravity has no SessionStart event; only an always_on rule
only via PreToolUse on the spawn tool

install.method: stage the compact rule, native agent selectors, complete opaque catalog data, stdio MCP server and hooks under <config>/config/plugins/coacus/; use --antigravity-profile full for legacy native skill and agent installation
